title: How to read this wiki
text: This is the in-game wiki of Multiverse of Anime in Tensura. One entry per system, in the order a new player meets them. Open it with the Multiverse Wiki book (craft it: book + amethyst shard + ender pearl) or from the Wiki tab of the Multiverse menu. Things you have not found yet still show as ??? in the other tabs; this tab is plain help and is always readable.
